authorized_actions: create one small RunPod network volume in an explicitly allowlisted data center
provision a secure-cloud RTX 5090 destination using the exact frozen image
rehydrate only content-addressed non-development H6 artifacts
run development-free destination admission and retrieve its receipt
release and transfer exactly the frozen known-development partition once
open and execute the frozen evaluator exactly once
download, hash, and preserve the evaluation result on two off-RunPod failure domains
stop the evaluation destination after result recovery or for cost containment

destination_policy.reason: The stopped source data center is not provider-observable and is not part of H6's scientific identity; exact destination runtime and content attestation remain mandatory.

failed_admission_rule: Capacity or exact-runtime admission failure ends this continuation without development release. A retry requires fresh provider evidence and a new no-clobber continuation authority.
objective: Execute H6's frozen, one-shot known-development evaluation solely to decide whether the state-conditioned boundary residual improves Nano, the trainable AI scribe.
prohibited_actions: restart or modify the recovered source pod
change the preregistration, gates, selector, evaluator, checkpoints, reports, tokenizer, or development partition
transfer or inspect development before development-free admission succeeds
run more than one development evaluation attempt
access fresh-v1, sealed confirmation, benchmarks, or private corpus data
start H7 or product, app, UI, service, or deployment work
termination_gate: Destination deletion is permitted only before development release after failed capacity/runtime admission, or after two verified result backups. Source termination remains forbidden.
